card.name: Words just before decide/determine/use
card.fires_on: Small linking or helper words (also, that, be, are, a comma) and odd digits or name pieces, where the next word could be a verb such as determine, decide, use or analyze.

modes.description: Small words like be, are, that, also or a comma sit just before a verb of deciding, determining or using.

card.writes: It suppresses decide/determine words as the next word, so it steers the model away from predicting them.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words where the model should not expect a word like 'determine' or 'decide' next.
